hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|astro|js)$' && npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -3 || true
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'src/content/docs/.*\.mdx$' && node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lint-prose.mjs" "$FILE" || true
